title: Improved bound on symmetric differences of intersecting families
summary: For a family $\mathcal{F}$, it is called intersecting if $F\cap F'\neq \emptyset$ for all $F,F'\in\mathcal{F}$. We use $\mathcal{SD}(\mathcal{F}) = \{F \triangle G : F, G \in \mathcal{F}\}$ to denote the family of symmetric differences of $\mathcal{F}$. In 2023, Frankl, Kiselev and Kupavskii conjectured that for any intersecting family $\mathcal{F} \subseteq \binom{[n]}{k}$ with $n > 10k$, the inequality $|\mathcal{SD}(\mathcal{F})| \le \sum_{\ell=0}^{k-1} \binom{n-1}{2\ell}$ holds.
